events.title: Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair

cases.refreshed: November 14, 2026 Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair is returning to Santana Row! We've rounded up the best local Artists, Crafters, Designers, and Makers for a truly unforgettable shopping experience for every second Saturday of every month from 11 AM-6 PM! 60+ Local Makers Handmade jewelry, permanent jewelry, ceramics, woodwork, apparel, leather goods, glass art, candles, local honey, apothecary, art, crochet, pet treats/products, handbags, plants, and more Great food + drinks in the surrounding eateries. This IS A SIP & Stroll Event! Bring your kids + fur babies Enjoy live music by local artists FREE to attend! Shop in store! Stroll into our brick-and-mortar shop (adjacent to the market area) for more American-made jewelry, apparel, body products, home goods and more from 100+ Makers.

cases.refreshed: Join our volunteer Kimmie for a study in the physics of light, specifically, how light bends when it passes through different materials. If we trap light within a material, we call this Total Internal Reflection. Kids will see and experience various demonstrations of this effect, then have a chance to build a small fiber optic light toy to play with during the program. This program is appropriate for kids in 2nd grade and up. Space is limited to 15 participants on a first come, first basis. Tickets will be available at the Front Desk one hour before the event begins to secure a spot.

cases.refreshed: Do you have...... a stuffed animal with the stuffing leaking out?... a shirt with a missing button?... a hole you want to patch?... a stain you want to cover up? Bring it to the Mend with Friends mending club and let's fix it together! If you are curious about sewing, we can also introduce beginners to some basic hand-sewing stitches. No registration is required; bring your own items to mend, project to work on, or practice basic stitches with our fabric scraps! Limited mending supplies for hand sewing and casual instruction are available, but bringing your own favorite tools, extra buttons, fabric scraps, or experience to share is always appreciated. Children are welcome to accompany their caregiver and learn alongside them. We meet every month on the second Saturday! For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
